owner_signature_observed.meaning: a valid on-chain ECDSA signature from the AtomWallet owner is observable after an executed UserOp

high_s_derivable.meaning: an observer can derive a high-s counterpart (s' = curve_order - s, v' = v XOR 1) recovering the identical signer address

high_s_signature_length_bytes.meaning: length in bytes of the derived high-s raw ECDSA signature

validate_userop_returns_failed.meaning: validateUserOp returns SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED (1) without reverting on signature mismatch
validate_userop_returns_failed.checkpoint: during EntryPoint handleOps validation of the griefing UserOp

bundler_simulation_reverts.meaning: bundler simulation of the griefing UserOp reverts
bundler_simulation_reverts.checkpoint: during bundler simulation of the griefing UserOp

bundler_compute_wasted.meaning: bundler compute is wasted on the griefing submission
bundler_compute_wasted.checkpoint: after bundler simulation of the griefing UserOp

assumptions: The griefing UserOp carries the derived high-s signature and targets an AtomWallet.
Bundler simulation is the execution step whose outcome is observed for this impact.

unresolved.description: Report describes the griefing submission and its effects as potential/conditional; it does not state that a griefing UserOp was actually observed on-chain.

limitations: Formalizes only the bundler-compute-waste impact; bundle-wide revert and gas loss are separate impacts not covered here.
Bundler retry/blacklist behavior is implementation-dependent and not asserted as observed.
